root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on الرُّمَّان, the pomegranate; it also records الرُّمَّانَتَانِ as the proper name of two hills in the land of ʿAbs.
root_idea.development: No abstract root principle is established in the supplied root entry. The recorded Classical extensions arise chiefly through resemblance to the pomegranate's form or color, or through association with pomegranates and their cultivation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under the normalized citation form رُمَّان.

senses.definition: The pomegranate, the well-known fruit produced by the pomegranate tree.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically used as a noun for pomegranates among earthly produce and in the description of Paradise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two hills called al-Rummānatān in the land of ʿAbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper geographical name in the dual.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The white poppy, or a species of white poppy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plant name based on resemblance to a pomegranate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large species of St John's-wort, or Androsæmum.
In later figurative usage, a young woman's small, round breasts; a reported expression may instead use the dual for the buttocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later, figurative usage; the buttocks interpretation is reported as uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The third stomach, or manyplies, of a ruminant; or the part of a horse that contains fodder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A colloquial specialized use of the singulative form رُمَّانَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an eating idiom, the navel and surrounding parts projecting from overeating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use, not a general anatomical definition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rounded knob or boss made of metal, wood, silk, or a similar material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension based on resemblance to the shape of a pomegranate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The weight of a steelyard or Roman balance; later also the steelyard itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension based on the object's form; the instrument itself may also be called رُومَانَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to the pomegranate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nisbah adjective derived from رُمَّان.
A substantivized occupational use of the nisbah form.
An adjectival color use derived from the characteristic color associated with the pomegranate.
A later substantivized use reported as figurative or specialized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of food prepared with pomegranates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food name derived from the ingredient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where pomegranate trees or their stems grow abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-name or place noun denoting abundant pomegranate growth.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Inflectional singulative cross-reference; it adds no independent lexical meaning.
Ruby-colored is grouped with the color branch.
Diminutive formation only; no independent lexical meaning.

cautions: Several varietal names listed within the pomegranate entry are explicitly flagged as requiring verification or correction and are not treated as separate lexical meanings. The later figurative and colloquial extensions are labeled accordingly rather than presented as Quranic usages.
